name: Satou Sayaka
source:
She almost made it through med school, but the inability to express herself outwardly through her fashion sense drove her mad. She happened to be expelled just before the outbreak hit her neighborhood, ensuring her a safe start at her apartment. The first thing she did was dye her hair.

Favorite Color: Lavender
Blood Type: O+
